title: How to aim CDF before CDF Next
decision: How to aim Cosmos Data Factory for the two quarters before CDF Next.

jensen.reason: The decision is whether CDF becomes the platform.

ng.reason: Does the data move the model.

brief: Cosmos Data Factory turns a customer's data into a labeled training set for physical AI, on the customer's own GPUs. CDF Next launches February 2027, with GTC San Jose in March 2027 as the success date. Revenue, team size, cash, and any founder lean are unknown.
assumptions: Revenue, margin, and team size are unknown
Cash, runway, and founder hours are unknown
